main.description: A resolution: the public outcome of a motion or election that the organisation has chosen to publish. Authored by the org's DID, not an individual member. The secret ballots and the working deliberation stay private in the org store; only this decided outcome becomes a record.

body.description: The resolution text, rendered from the stored rich content.

status.description: The decided outcome. Open (closed strings only; extend via knownValues, never a breaking enum change).

context.description: Optional: the public group or event this resolution belongs to.
